label: preparing
what: An apparent coordinated, undisclosed preparation around a proposed bridge or port change, associated with a meeting at the bakery. The baker also arranged delivery of eighty loaves to the hall for the lighting inspection; the records do not establish that this delivery is part of the bridge/port preparation. The baker, innkeeper, and neighbour are explicitly named as present in connection with the bakery discussion; freight relayed the hall appointment and loaf-delivery information, but the evidence does not show freight knowingly helping the bridge/port effort. The mayor was not told directly of the proposal, and the secretary reports no confirmed formal proposal, so its exact nature and whether it is more than discussion remain uncertain.
